description: This file defines a React functional component named ProtectedRoute, which acts as a route guard. It checks user authentication status and roles using the useSupabaseAuth hook, and conditionally renders loading states, redirects unauthenticated users to /signin, and handles role-based authorization by redirecting unauthorized users to /not-authorized.

methods.name: ProtectedRoute
methods.description: Functional React component serving as a route guard, managing authentication and role-based access control.
